Hello!
I love how fluffy you draw characters, especially the hair!
I really liked these past works from you:

I'd love to request my OC Neeko if you don't mind! In this outfit she's a demon race queen.
I hope it's okay if she is not a furry character!

Please feel free to do whatever you would like with the pose and expression! If you'd like an idea for pose, maybe something like the following? https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mNaaO8WsBZ6JQgfgn8oOXiveXvtQ_3rY/view?usp=drive_link

Feel free to adjust anything that you would like to, thank you for the consideration!
